author: Samantha
text: Had a in bank storm shelter installed. Installation was quickly scheduled. The installers were very knowledgeable and explained all questions I had. They perfectly leveled the shelter and the seams haven't leaked with the heavy rains we've had. Service and communication with Wells Septic was great. The price of the shelter was very reasonable for the quality of the shelter. I would definitely recommend their storm shelters.

author: James Colburn
text: These guys are experts on septic systems. Any item that is part of a septic tank is available.  The staff are knowledgeable and extremely friendly.  They also sell and install storm shelters. While I was talking to one individual about the storm shelters, another gathered the part I needed, and instead of bringing me the parts, he actually loaded them into my truck. Prior to me leaving, they gave me a thorough tutorial on the proper installation.  (I purchased an access hatch for my septic tank to simplify future clean out. I'm a novice, but after following their instructions,  installation went perfectly. ) I would recommend this company for any of your septic tank needs and for storm shelters.

author: Jared Smith
text: Always great folks to deal with. They carry most everything septic related.  Some items you will have to be a licensed installer to buy. But there are some items that the average homeowner can purchase. They also carry storm shelters and othe items.

text: Best place for material.and couldn't ask for better customer service.

author: Kristin Underwood
text: Very nice people! We had a quick response and a very decent price to get it completed.
